ana_ops: Heads-up: vendor updated PO# 908776 schedule. Main wave slips from 2026-07-05 -> 2026-07-28. They offered an express-air split for 30 H100 units with a premium.
leo_procure: pls paste vendor terms.
ana_ops: (typo) ana_ops: Vendor note: "Can air-ship 30 H100s ETA 2026-07-15 for +3.2% expedite fee + air uplift. Remaining H100s sea 2026-07-28. A800s unchanged. Can include 5-unit RMA buffer as credit if unused."
sanjay_infra: We're ~3% below targeted reserve in us-west compute pools. Losing those 30 will impact several SLOs. Getting 20 routed to us-west fixes it.
leo_procure: Counter-proposal: 2% expedite + vendor covers air-to-hub freight, we cover final-mile for EU returns; vendor provides 5-unit RMA buffer that becomes an invoice credit if unused within 21 days. Ask them to hold serial manifest 72h prior.
tess_logistics: inbound note: if split-air happens, need separate intake SOP for express tranche. Consolidated AWB to LAX-HUB for US returns is mandatory to avoid depot thrash. Also need photo evidence and CSV manifest before acceptance.
Vendor: We can do 2% expedite and 5-unit RMA reserve credited if unused. Air uplift per unit estimate $350. We will provide serial manifest 72h pre-flight and will consolidate returns to LAX-HUB on single AWB if buyer accepts final-mile for EU returns.
leo_procure: push for vendor to reduce uplift to $300/unit and add thermal failure SLA: vendor pays return freight + unit credit if DOA rate >1.5% on arrival. Also include a rollback clause: if usable yield < 94% we want an immediate top-up tranche within 7 days.
sanjay_infra: add operational req: inventory tags on receipt must mark RMA-buffer and "express-hold" so autoscaler ignores buffer for 10 days. Netsec: cross-pool tunnel if we route any units from APAC temporarily. Need reimage lead time 18-24h.
nana_ops: ana_ops: also confirm insurance extension for air transit. If vendor's air policy doesn't cover thermal, we need vendor to accept return freight liability for thermal faults >1.5%.
leo_procure: Draft amendment to vendor: 2% expedite, $300 uplift, 5-unit RMA credit if unused, vendor covers air-to-hub freight, vendor covers return freight & unit credit if DOA>1.5%, 72h preflight serial manifest, consolidated AWB to LAX-HUB, rollback top-up if usable<94% within 7d. Request written acceptance by COB.
rma_bot: Automated: Created draft RMA ticket RMA-20260715-11 for express tranche; assigned to tess_logistics.
tess_logistics: Acknowledged. I'll create intake SOP and AWB template. Snippet: ```
Express tranche intake checklist:
- 72h preflight serial manifest (CSV) to logistics@redwood.com
- Single inbound AWB to LAX-HUB for US returns
- EU intake: photo evidence + serial match; buyer covers final-mile customs clearance up to $1,100/unit unless vendor accepts liability for thermal SLA
- RMA buffer: 5 units held as credit; vendor to issue credit memo if unused within 21 days
- Thermal SLA: vendor covers return freight & unit credit if DOA >1.5%
- Rollback/top-up: vendor commits to replacement tranche within 7 days if usable yield <94%
```
nana_ops: ana_ops: ops approves conditional on written vendor acceptance. Also assign on-call flag to infra for receipt window.
sanjay_infra: infra approves. Will reserve capacity tags and stand up cross-pool loan plan if vendor can't commit.
leo_procure: emailing vendor contact now (cc legal). Will update thread when vendor confirms. If vendor declines any SLA points, fallback is accept late sea shipment and trigger APAC->US loan of 20 A800s for short-term headroom.
nana_ops: ana_ops: thanks. Marking as high-priority procurement negotiation. :thumbsup:
